verdict.rationale: Smithery is a hosted MCP connection and registry platform, so data portability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no export feature for connections, namespaces, metadata or account data in any format. Credential storage is described as write-only, and an adjacent publishing feature (static server cards) is not a user data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
